title: Inner-product determinant covectors exist for every frame
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let w = (w_1, …, w_n) be any family of n vectors in ℝ^P (w : Fin n → Euclid P). Then there is an n-covector β on ℝ^P, i.e. a continuous alternating n-linear form β : (ℝ^P)^n → ℝ (β ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n), such that for every u = (u_1, …, u_n) ∈ (ℝ^P)^n, β(u_1, …, u_n) = det(⟨u_a, w_b⟩)_{a,b}. Here (⟨u_a, w_b⟩)_{a,b} is the n×n real matrix whose entry in row a and column b is the Euclidean inner product ⟨u_a, w_b⟩, i.e. Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (u a) (w b)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (w : Fin n → Euclid P), ∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, ∀ u : Fin n → Euclid P, β u = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (u a) (w b))
